summary: Iteration 13 regression pass verified. Backend query caps on /api/vessels/{mmsi}/profile and scoped watchlist $in lookup on /api/cases/{id}/candidates work correctly. 3/3 new pytest cases pass. Frontend vessel profile page (/vessels/244123456) renders NORDIC TRADER with KPIs (Case Appearances 11, Ranked#1 8, Probable/Confirmed 4) and full appearances table. Case detail (SPL-20260610-001) Candidates tab renders with WATCHLIST badge (data-testid=watchlist-badge-636998877) attached to ATLAS VOYAGER. No regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: vessel_profile: uses count_documents for total_fixes and .sort(-1).limit(5000).to_list().reverse() for chronological order — correct approach; note that when total_fixes > 5000, first_seen reflects only the earliest of the most-recent 5000, which is semantically 'analysed window' not true first_seen. Consider adding a separate min-timestamp aggregation if a case ever hits >5000 fixes for a single MMSI. Not blocking (seed case has 57).
correlation_results limit 500 with latest_by_case dedupe by version DESC is correct; downstream cases $in list is capped by MAX_PROFILE_RESULTS which is fine.
candidates endpoint watchlist $in query is now scoped to only candidate MMSIs (was previously unbounded). Good perf fix. Projection excludes _id — no ObjectId leak.
Non-watchlisted candidates correctly receive watchlist:null via watch.get(mmsi) default. Verified in API response and UI (badge only on 636998877).
